newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo slips quickly to predicted low on mark.
newsitem.headline: Escudo slips quickly to predicted low on mark.

text.p: The escudo was trading at 100.80/85 to the mark in early trade, sharply down from its opening 100.65/67 and its close at 100.66/69 on Wednesday.
The currency was already at the bottom of the 100.50-80 range traders had predicted for the session.

Traders said the currency was coming under some pressure over speculation about what might be its entry rate into Europe's planned single currency as confidence mounts that Portugal will be in the first wave of members.
Portugal's Banco Cisf said on Tuesday that the rate could be its European exchange rate mechanism mid-point of 102.50.
